note: out of place = cell of a type that forms sheets with < 20% of its 15 nearest cells in its lineage; a candidate area = touching 100 um tiles with >= 6 such cells of one lineage and >= 3x the count expected from cell density (a local excess; a diffuse spread shows only in out_of_place_by_lineage: view it with show_tissue_overview(highlight)); composition = lineage shares of all cells in the area. Candidates are computed from the annotation only: confirm them on the overview and H&E before suggesting anything. Areas the user marked as solved are left out (solved_by_user): do not raise them again.
